howto.name: Upload a PNG
howto.text: Drop a .png file up to 500 MB.

howto.name: PrivaTools converts via Pillow
howto.text: BMP has no practical transparency support, so any alpha channel is composited onto white.

howto.name: Convert and download
howto.text: Click Convert. BMP has no practical transparency support, so any alpha channel is composited onto a white background. Keep the PNG if transparency matters.

faq.q: Is PNG transparency kept in BMP?
faq.a: No. The alpha channel is dropped rather than blended onto white, so transparent areas usually come out black in the BMP. If you need to keep transparency, use PNG to TIFF instead.
For legacy Windows software, embedded displays, and tools that only accept uncompressed bitmap input.
It runs on the PrivaTools server with local image libraries, not a third-party API. The files are temporary and are removed by response cleanup after the BMP is sent.
